Label: com.ravynos.firefoxtest
ProgramArguments:
set -x; echo '[fftest] start'; mkdir -p /var/tmp/ff/profile; cd /var/tmp/ff; echo '

ravynOS Firefox

' > /var/tmp/ff/test.html; /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox -CreateProfile 'ravyntest /var/tmp/ff/profile' 2>&1; echo '[fftest] create rc='$?; : > /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.aboutwelcome.enabled", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.newtabpage.enabled", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.startup.homepage", "file:///var/tmp/ff/test.html");' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.startup.page", 1);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.shell.checkDefaultBrowser", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("datareporting.policy.dataSubmissionEnabled", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("toolkit.telemetry.reportingpolicy.firstRun", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("gfx.webrender.software", true);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("layers.acceleration.disabled", true);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; echo 'user_pref("browser.tabs.remote.autostart", false);' >> /var/tmp/ff/profile/user.js; exec /usr/local/compat/runas -t 90 0 0 /bin/sh -c 'export RAVYN_DYLD_IMAGES=1; exec /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox -profile /var/tmp/ff/profile -no-remote -foreground -width 1024 -height 768 file:///var/tmp/ff/test.html' 2>&1; echo '[fftest] runas rc='$?
